name: io.github.tonyyang0504/doba-mcp
description: Doba (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping, create_order, get_order,

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: appKey assigned by Doba (Retailer API > Generate Key, https://open.doba.com/apidoc/retailer/developer/key); sent as the appKey header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your RSA private key from the same page, as PEM: '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' + the base64 PKCS#8 key Doba shows + '-----END PRIVATE KEY-----' (newlines may be written as \n). Signs 'appKey=…&signType=rsa2&timestamp=…' with SHA256withRSA; never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DOBA_PLATFORM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Doba dsPlatformId of the marketplace your orders come from (Import Order): 1 Amazon, 2 eBay, 3 Shopify, 7 BigCommerce, 8 WooCommerce, 13 Walmart, 19 TikTok Shop, 26 Etsy, 99 Others (https://open.doba.com/apidoc/retailer).
